# CooPrompt

> CooPrompt is a desktop client (Electron) for the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor coding-agent engines, built for teams. Several people work with the agent in the same chat: each request runs on the requester's own computer with that person's credentials, while the conversation, the agent's tool activity, permission requests and a synced working folder are shared live through a small team server (Fastify, WebSocket, node:sqlite) that any CooPrompt can host. Windows support is experimental; see the README for platform limitations.

- Monorepo with npm workspaces, TypeScript in strict mode, ES modules, Node 24: `packages/protocol` (the wire contract), `apps/server` (the team server), `apps/desktop` (Electron 45, React 19, Tailwind 4).
- The server never receives model credentials; secrets stay in each computer's encrypted store, protected by the operating system.
- Interface strings are English source text with a Spanish dictionary; the server always speaks English.
- Commands: `npm install`, `npm run dev`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run server`, `npm run dist`.

## Source entry points

- [packages/protocol/src/index.ts](packages/protocol/src/index.ts): shared types, REST payloads and the WebSocket message unions
- [apps/server/src/cli.ts](apps/server/src/cli.ts): standalone server entry point and its environment variables
- [apps/server/src/server.ts](apps/server/src/server.ts): `createCooPromptServer`, wiring of the HTTP routes and the WebSocket hub
- [apps/server/src/routes.ts](apps/server/src/routes.ts): HTTP API for accounts, chats, turns and invitations
- [apps/server/src/hub.ts](apps/server/src/hub.ts): realtime hub, presence and the per-chat turn queue, with multitask turns
- [apps/server/src/files.ts](apps/server/src/files.ts): shared workspace file API
- [apps/server/src/automations.ts](apps/server/src/automations.ts): automations and their scheduler (missed runs, catch-ups, time limits)
- [apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts): Electron entry point and IPC channel
- [apps/desktop/src/main/core.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/core.ts): app core and the IPC method handlers
- [apps/desktop/src/shared/types.ts](apps/desktop/src/shared/types.ts): the `CooPromptApi` IPC table and app types
- [apps/desktop/src/main/runner/runner.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/runner/runner.ts): turn execution on the requester's computer
- [apps/desktop/src/main/engines/](apps/desktop/src/main/engines/): Claude Agent SDK and Codex SDK adapters, the Cursor CLI's ACP client, model provider presets
- [apps/desktop/src/main/connectors.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/connectors.ts): MCP connectors and OAuth
- [apps/desktop/src/main/sync/workspace-sync.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/sync/workspace-sync.ts): two-way shared workspace mirror
- [apps/desktop/src/main/host.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/host.ts): embedded team server and Cloudflare quick tunnel
- [apps/desktop/src/main/tunnel.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/tunnel.ts): the quick tunnel's health checks and replacement
- [apps/desktop/src/main/updater.ts](apps/desktop/src/main/updater.ts): updates from the team server, download verification and the swap helper ([update-helper.sh](apps/desktop/resources/update-helper.sh))
- [apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/App.tsx](apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/App.tsx): React UI root

## Optional

- [apps/server/test/collaboration.test.ts](apps/server/test/collaboration.test.ts): end-to-end server behavior with real HTTP and WebSocket clients
- [apps/desktop/test/workspace-sync.test.ts](apps/desktop/test/workspace-sync.test.ts): shared workspace sync between two mirrors
- [apps/desktop/test/connector-sources.test.ts](apps/desktop/test/connector-sources.test.ts): reading other apps' MCP definitions and planning per engine
- [apps/server/.env.example](apps/server/.env.example): example standalone server configuration
- [apps/desktop/src/shared/i18n-es.ts](apps/desktop/src/shared/i18n-es.ts): Spanish dictionary
